in_marathi.name: Anuraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pleaser of Lord Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anuraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anu (Anu- Anu, meaning 'one after another' or 'step by step') + Raja (Raj- Raja, meaning 'king' or 'rule'). Anuraj is a name that signifies the one who pleases Lord Rama.

in_bengali.name: Anuraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Pleaser of Lord Rama
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anuraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Anu (Anu- Anu, meaning 'one after another' or 'step by step') + Raja (Raj- Raja, meaning 'king' or 'rule'). Anuraj is a name that signifies the one who pleases Lord Rama.
